scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Whew...!
Still, he won't eat anything unless it's Meat. But maybe he will eat fruit if it was cut so that it was easy to eat. Like, if it was blended into juice...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
呼...！
不過，他只肯吃肉。也許把水果切成方便入口的小塊，他就願意吃了，比如打成果汁...

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Ah! Come to think of it, I heard they were making fruit juice somewhere. Now where was it... Payon Village, or Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
啊！說起來，我聽說有個地方在做果汁。是在哪裡來著...斐揚村，還是夢羅克？

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! Eat some fruits!! You don't want to become a slobby fat pig when you grow up, do you?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
莫里森！！快吃點水果！！你長大後可不想變成邋遢的胖豬吧？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Hm? ...You!
You're the one who gave, my little Morrison that Meat?! Did you come here thinking I wouldn't know about it?!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
嗯？...是你！
就是你給我家小莫里森肉吃的？！你以為我會不知道嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Go away, get out of my house NOW!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
滾出去，現在馬上滾出我家！！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! I'm going to be very very mad if you keep doing this!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
莫里森！！你要是再這樣，我可要大發雷霆了！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Oh!!.... This...
what is this...??
How could you do something like this to my boy?!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
啊！！...這...
這是什麼...？
你怎麼能對我兒子做這種事？！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Argh! Get out of my house right this instant!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
啊！ 現在馬上給我滾出家門！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! Please eat some fruits!! Please~!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
莫里森！！求你吃點水果吧！！拜託了~！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marinaa]
Sigh~!! Like father, like son...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
嘆氣~！！ 真是有其父必有其子...

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
*Sigh*... This is Morrison...
My one and only son.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
*嘆氣*...這就是莫里森...
我唯一的兒子。

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
But these days, he just won't eat fruits. His face is so dull because he refuses to eat healthy. He just wants to eat Meat. I need to find a way to feed him fruits or vegetables....
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
可最近他就是不肯吃水果。因為不肯吃健康的食物，他的臉色都變差了。他只想吃肉。我得想辦法讓他吃水果或蔬菜...

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! You're going to be in big trouble if you keep this up!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安太太]
莫里森！！你再這樣下去可要惹上大麻煩了！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Bleh... Forget it.
I'm just going to shrivel to death just eating fruits. Don't bother worrying about me .
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
唉...算了。
光吃水果我會瘦成乾的。別替我操心。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Ah... so full~
I think I can live now.
You don't have to give me any more Meat. I feel like I'm going to explode if I eat any more.
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
啊...好飽~
我想我這下能活下去了。
不用再給我肉了，再吃下去我就要撐爆了。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Oh... and... um.
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
哦...還有...那個。
拿著這個。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
It's a little something I've been saving to eat for later, but since you gave me Meat, I think I can pass on the sweets.
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
這是我留著以後吃的小零食，不過既然你給了我肉，我想甜食就可以讓給你了。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Agh....Noooo!!!
No, don't make me eat it! I can't bear to taste fruits!
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
啊...不！！！
不，別逼我吃！我受不了水果的味道！

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Show the Meat
scripts.translation: 出示肉

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Aaaagh!! Once or twice is enough!! I refuse to eat any more fruits! You have to peel them and there's so much juice that it makes you feel icky...
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
啊啊啊！！ 吃一兩次就夠了！！我再也不吃水果了！還得剝皮，汁水又多，弄得人黏糊糊的...

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
And they're all slippery and sour... Even if I eat it, I still feel hungry. Aaaah~! Give me Meat!
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
而且水果又滑又酸...就算吃了，我還是覺得餓。啊啊~！給我肉！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Ooh! M-Meaaat~
Ah... hu...hungry...
The scent of Meat...
Excuse me...
C-can I please have one?
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
噢！肉...肉~
啊...好...好餓...
肉的香味...
打擾了...
能...能給我一塊嗎？

scripts.text: Give Meat
scripts.translation: 給肉

scripts.text: Don't Give Meat
scripts.translation: 不給肉

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Wow~!!! Meat!!
So yummy!
Thank you,
I think I can
live now.
*Chew chew*
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
哇~！！！肉！！
太好吃了！
謝謝你，
我想我現在
能活下去了。
*嚼嚼*

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Waah...!
Fine, I get it now.
Adults are all the same!
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
哇...！
好吧，我懂了。
大人都一個樣！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Aaaaah!!! No matter what, I'm not going to eat fruits and vegetables!
scripts.translation:
[小莫里森]
啊啊啊！！！ 不管怎樣，我就是不吃水果和蔬菜！

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Welcome.
Did you come to
process fruits as well?
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
歡迎光臨。
您也是來加工水果的嗎？

scripts.text: Make Juice.
scripts.translation: 製作果汁

scripts.text: Talk and get information about fruit processing.
scripts.translation: 交談，瞭解水果加工方式

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
What kind of fruit juice would you like to make?
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
您想製作哪種果汁？

scripts.text: Apple Juice
scripts.translation: 蘋果汁

scripts.text: Banana Juice
scripts.translation: 香蕉汁

scripts.text: Carrot Juice
scripts.translation: 胡蘿蔔汁

scripts.text: Grape Juice
scripts.translation: 葡萄汁

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
See you next time.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
那麼...
下次再見。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Oh no...
You don't have all the necessary materials. To make {0}, I need 1 {1} and 1 Empty Bottle. I will also need a 3 zeny fee.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
哎呀...
您沒有備齊所需材料。製作{0}需要1個{1}和1個空瓶，另外還要支付3 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
When you have prepared everything, I will blend the fruit to give you delicious juice.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
備齊材料後，我就把水果榨成果汁給您。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
How many would you like?
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
您想製作多少瓶？

scripts.text: As many as I can.
scripts.translation: 儘可能多地製作

scripts.text: I want a certain amount.
scripts.translation: 指定數量

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Choose a number less than 100. If you don't want to, put '0'. You can make up to {0} bottles of juice.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
請輸入小於100的數量。如果不製作，請輸入“0”。您最多可以製作{0}瓶果汁。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
那麼...
歡迎再來。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
More than 100 bottles is impossible. Choose a different amount.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
超過100瓶是不可能的，請重新選擇數量。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
那麼...
歡迎再來。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Oh no...
You don't have all the necessary materials. I can't help a situation like this. I guess you collect what you need.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
哎呀...
您沒有備齊所需材料，這種情況我也幫不上忙。把需要的材料收集齊再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Here you go! Fresh and delicious juice as promised. It should be very refreshing and palatable.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
給您！這是答應您的新鮮美味果汁，清爽可口。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
那麼...
歡迎再來。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Before humans were able to develop such vast societies, they gathered fruit from trees to survive. Fruits may have been nature's blessing that allowed us to exist in the world.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
在人類建立起龐大的社會之前，人們靠採摘樹上的果實維生。水果或許是大自然的恩賜，讓我們得以在世上生存。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Since life became so prosperous, the younger generation seems not to eat fruit any more. So, I started thinking of ways to make fruit easier to eat.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
如今生活富足，年輕一代似乎不再吃水果了。所以我開始琢磨，怎樣才能讓水果更方便食用。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
I realized that when you make fruit juice, it's more convenient to eat and has a much better taste.
scripts.translation:
[商人馬克斯·漢森]
我發現，把水果做成果汁，不僅食用起來更方便，味道也更好。
